correctness.rationale: The lower bound follows from a published connected-subchain reduction, central symmetry, and an explicit diameter estimate. The upper bound is realized by disks centered at offsets b/2 from the polygon center and is checked by an exact squared-distance inequality for every vertex. Convexity covers the intervening edges and half-polygons. The uniqueness statement follows from strictness for non-midpoint starts and from two forced diameter pairs.
